mapper.update: update SYS_FileAnnex set archive=#{archive}, upload_status=1 where file_Id in (select fa.file_Id from SYS_FileAnnex fa left join Archive_File af on af.Af_Annex_Id = fa.file_id where af.Ap_Id = #{apId})
mapper.select:
select * from SYS_FileAnnex where file_id in
#{id}
select fa.* from SYS_FileAnnex fa left join Archive_File af on af.Af_Annex_Id = fa.file_id where af.Ap_Id = #{apId}

select distinct Table_Code,column_Code from SYS_FileAnnex where column_Code is not null and column_Code!='undefined' and column_Code!='' and Table_Code in
#{tableCode}

select sf.fileid as sysFileId, sf.T_Code as tCode, sf.FileProject as pId, sf.FileSectionID as secId, sf.FileContract as conId, sfn.* from sys_fileannex sfn left join sys_file sf on sf.fileid = sfn.file_entity_id where upload_status = 1 and archive = 0 and File_Location = 0 and file_entity_id is not null and File_Source_Type = '01' and (sf.FileProject is not null or sf.FileSectionID is not null or sf.FileContract is not null) and sf.T_Code is not null and sf.FileFlowStatus = 7 order by sfn.file_upload_time desc

select * from (select sf.fileid as sysFileId, sf.T_Code as tCode, (select pro.P_Id from Pre_Project pro left join Pre_Pro_Proposal pp on pp.Pp_Code = pro.P_Code where pp.PP_Id = sfn.file_entity_id) as pId, sf.FileSectionID as secId, sf.FileContract as conId, sfn.* from sys_fileannex sfn left join sys_file sf on sf.fileid = sfn.file_entity_id where upload_status = 1 and archive = 0 and File_Location = 0 and file_entity_id in (select Pp_Id from Pre_Pro_Proposal where Pp_State = 7) and File_Source_Type = '01' and sf.T_Code is not null and sf.FileFlowStatus = 7 order by sfn.file_entity_id asc) f where f.pId is not null
mapper.update:
update Sys_FileAnnex set upload_status=1 where archive=1 and file_location=1 and file_id in
#{id}
mapper.select: select mn.* from Sys_FileAnnex mn left join Archive_File af on af.Af_Annex_Id=mn.file_id left join Archive ar on ar.Ap_Id=af.Ap_Id where ar.Ad_Id=#{adId} and af.Af_State=1

select mn.* from Sys_FileAnnex mn where mn.upload_status=1 and File_Location=1 and File_MD5_Code=#{jmValue} and (select count(*) from Archive_File af where af.Af_Annex_Id=mn.file_id)>0 order by mn.file_upload_time desc limit 1
select sfa.*,sf.FileCode as code from sys_fileannex sfa left join sys_file sf on sf.FileID=sfa.file_id where sfa.upload_status = 1

select sfa.*,qpt.pt_code as code from sys_fileannex sfa left join qs_record qr on qr.Qsr_Id = sfa.File_Entity_Id left join Qs_Plan_Task qpt on qpt.id=qr.Pt_Id where sfa.upload_status = 1 and qr.Qsr_Id IS NOT NULL
SELECT * FROM sys_fileannex WHERE File_MD5_Code IS NULL AND upload_status = 1 ORDER BY file_upload_time desc LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
